blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has reaffirmed the government’s commitment to supporting Filipino athletes and expanding sports development programs nationwide. During a courtesy call by the Philippine Fencing Association (PFA) at Malacañan Palace, Marcos said his administration would continue promoting wider participation in sports, including fencing, to give more young Filipinos opportunities to develop their skills and compete at higher levels.
